scientific limitations/integrity: The result classifies the equality cases for the one-standard-deviation Rademacher tail only when at most five coefficients are nonzero. It does not classify the six-variable or unrestricted global extremizers, and it does not concern the strict-tail variant. The proof is analytic; the finite integer-grid script is a regression check rather than the proof. A residual originality risk remains for an unindexed equivalent subset-sum classification.
title: Complete minimizer geometry for the five-coordinate Hitczenko–Kwapień constant
